# 資深人力資源高管、AI 治理顧問與三體系主導稽核員

## 1. Professional Summary (專業簡介)
- **English**: Jacky Law is a Hong Kong-based Senior Human Resources Executive and Corporate Governance Advisor with over 15 years of corporate leadership experience. Guided by a "Human-Centric & Simplicity" philosophy (以人為本・大巧不工), he bridges the gap between organizational transformation and technical oversight. He translates responsible AI principles and workforce strategies into verifiable **Governance-as-Code** prototypes, backed by Triple-ISO Lead Auditor credentials (ISO 42001, ISO 27701, ISO 27001).
- **中文**: 羅子淇（Jacky Law）是一位在香港擁有超過 15 年企業管理經驗的資深人力資源高管與企業管治顧問。秉持「以人為本・大巧不工」的初心，他致力於連繫組織變革、AI 治理與爭議解決。他將負責任 AI 原則與人力資本戰略轉化為可審計之「代碼即管治（Governance-as-Code）」實體系統，並以 Triple-ISO 主導稽核員資質構建企業風控底座。

## 2. Strategic Credentials & Professional Moat (核心專業資質護城河)
- **Executive HR Leadership (人力資源高階領導)**: Fellow Member of HKIHRM (**F.I.H.R.M.(HK)**). Over 15 years leading high-stakes corporate transformation. (香港人力資源管理學會資深會員)
- **Board-Level Corporate Governance (董事會級管治)**: Fellow Member of The Hong Kong Institute of Directors (**FHKIoD**). Embedding ethical AI and risk oversight into executive agendas. (香港董事學會資深會員)
- **IT Leadership & Professional Tech (科技領袖認證)**: Full Member of Hong Kong Computer Society (**MHKCS**); Member & Team Leader in **HKCS iLEAP (Cohort 8)** (資訊科技卓越領袖培育計劃第八期成員兼組長).
- **Triple-ISO Lead Auditor (三體系主導稽核員)**: 
  * **ISO/IEC 42001:2023** (Artificial Intelligence Management System - AIMS 人工智能管理體系)
  * **ISO/IEC 27701:2019** (Privacy Information Management System - PIMS 隱私資訊管理體系)
  * **ISO/IEC 27001:2022** (Information Security Management System - ISMS 資訊安全管理體系)
- **Cross-Border Dispute Resolution (跨境爭議解決)**: Designated **GBA Mediator (Department of Justice, HKSAR)** & APCAM Certified Trainer. (律政司認可大灣區調解員，逾 16 年爭議解決經驗)
- **Cloud AI Engineering (雲端生成式 AI 專業)**: Certified **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Generative AI Professional**. (甲骨文生成式 AI 專業人員認證)
- **Academic Backbone (學術背景)**: Master of Laws (**LL.M. in Common Law**) & Master of Arts (**M.A. in Sociology**), The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK). (香港中文大學普通法法學碩士 & 社會學文學碩士)
